name: spreadsheets
description: 创建、编辑、分析和导出本地 Excel 工作簿，支持公式与计算结果校验。预览渲染存在运行时异常；实时 Excel 和 Google Sheets 连接器尚未接入。

interface.longDescription: Create, edit, inspect, render, verify, and export XLSX, CSV, and TSV spreadsheets locally, including local XLSX authoring for native Google Sheets handoff. Use Spreadsheets when the durable output or target is a spreadsheet, workbook, sheet, Google Sheet, or CSV file.
